name: servers
sql: SELECT server AS name, count() AS sessions FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(McpServers) AS server FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) GROUP BY name ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 5

name: calls
sql: SELECT tool AS name, count() AS calls FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(McpTools) AS tool FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}) GROUP BY name

name: total
sql: SELECT count() AS n FROM agent_sessions WHERE StartedAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND StartedAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
